userStories.title: Add grading helper function for moneyline bets
userStories.description: As a system, I need to grade moneyline bets based on the game winner.
acceptanceCriteria: Create gradeBet helper function in auto_refresh_games or _shared
For moneyline: compare home vs away score to determine winner
Bet side matching winning team → return 'won'
Bet side matching losing team → return 'lost'
Tie game → return 'push'
Function takes bet record, home_score, away_score as parameters
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add grading logic for spread bets
userStories.description: As a system, I need to grade spread bets based on point differential.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend gradeBet function to handle spread market type
Parse spread value from bet side string (e.g., 'Lakers -3.5' → -3.5) using regex
Calculate adjusted score: team score + spread
If adjusted score > opponent → 'won'
If adjusted score < opponent → 'lost'
If exactly equal → 'push'
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add grading logic for total (over/under) bets
userStories.description: As a system, I need to grade over/under bets based on combined score.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend gradeBet function to handle total market type
Parse total value from bet side (e.g., 'Over 220.5' → 220.5) using regex
Calculate combined score: homeScore + awayScore
If combined > total and bet is Over → 'won'
If combined < total and bet is Under → 'won'
If combined equals total exactly → 'push'
Otherwise → 'lost'
Typecheck passes
